inference.primary: Three-dimensional Gaussian-eliminated feature test at true target; no target Jacobian inverse. Also evaluate alpha=2 submodel, which if accepted forces full drift-box projection.
inference.comparator: Exact five-feature inverse Wald joint ellipsoid when interior and inside fitting box; nonreturn counts as noncoverage. Not substituted by constrained optimization.
inference.retained_payload: Every eliminated feature vector, covariance estimate, raw CF minimum, truth, seed and observation hash. Enough to recompute all tests without rerunning estimates.

adaptive.candidate_order: increasing ell+j, then increasing j; ell>=1, j>=0, u=0.5*2**(-j); ell+j <= ceil(log n)
adaptive.agreement: max absolute feature residual / max max-absolute model feature,1e-12 <= n**(-1/4)
adaptive.scope: Pointwise selection theorem only. No uniform postselection coverage. Oracle alone uses true error support; primary methods do not.
adaptive.loss: Capped normalized squared signal-parameter error in log kappa,alpha,log C, using common fitting box; failure loss 1.

skew.scope: True phase coefficient is checked < pi for each predetermined population cell. No uniform unwrapping certification for an unbounded parameter domain. Known-signal estimator is an oracle diagnostic only.
skew.generator: CMS S1 innovations; alpha=1 scaling and stationary innovation location corrections included explicitly.

policy: Source, common numerical core and protocol frozen before path generation. Every failed, clipped and boundary case retained. No primary replacement or retuning after viewing outcomes. Not an external preregistration. Earlier paper and research archives remain unchanged.
